description: Technology choices are selected per task. Nothing in this file is installed by being listed.

libraries.description: Semantic static pages and lightweight documents.
libraries.install_instructions: No package. Do not install a framework for a document.
libraries.expected_output: A semantic document.
libraries.failure_fallback: Stop. Do not add a framework to paper over broken markup.

libraries.description: Small browser scripts without an application build.
libraries.install_instructions: No package unless the page already has one.
libraries.expected_output: A small script.
libraries.failure_fallback: Keep the page usable with the script disabled.

libraries.description: Default language for a substantial production application.
libraries.install_instructions: Project-scoped. Do not install globally.
libraries.expected_output: Typed application code.
libraries.failure_fallback: Report the missing toolchain. Do not install it globally.

libraries.description: Interactive component interfaces.
libraries.install_instructions: Project-scoped. Do not install globally.
libraries.expected_output: Components with a clear state boundary.
libraries.failure_fallback: Use the framework the repo already has.

libraries.description: Full-stack React with server rendering, routing, and server/client boundaries.
libraries.install_instructions: Project-scoped. Do not install globally.
libraries.expected_output: A Next.js application with an explicit server/client boundary.
libraries.failure_fallback: Stay on the framework the repo already uses.

libraries.description: Client-rendered applications and dashboards.
libraries.install_instructions: Project-scoped. Do not install globally.
libraries.expected_output: A client application.
libraries.failure_fallback: Use the existing bundler.

libraries.description: Content-heavy and static-first websites.
libraries.install_instructions: Project-scoped. Do not install globally.
libraries.expected_output: A content site with little client JavaScript.
libraries.failure_fallback: Use semantic HTML if the content does not need a site generator.

libraries.description: Timelines, ScrollTrigger, pinned sections, scrub, and cinematic choreography.
libraries.install_instructions: Project-scoped only after scroll or a timeline is actually required. Confirm the current license. Do not install globally.
libraries.expected_output: One scroll owner and one timeline.
libraries.failure_fallback: CSS transitions for a single hover. Do not add a second motion engine.

libraries.description: Component transitions, layout animation, hover, and drag. This is not the Framer website builder.
libraries.install_instructions: Project-scoped. Do not install globally. Do not confuse this package with a Framer project.
libraries.expected_output: Component motion that does not own the scroll container.
libraries.failure_fallback: CSS. Do not add GSAP for a hover.

libraries.description: Optional smooth scrolling when the experience requires one scroller.
libraries.install_instructions: Project-scoped only when smooth scroll is required. Do not install globally.
libraries.expected_output: One scroller shared with ScrollTrigger when both are selected.
libraries.failure_fallback: Native scroll.

libraries.description: Direct Three.js scene, or the renderer underneath React Three Fiber.
libraries.install_instructions: Project-scoped. Do not install globally.
libraries.expected_output: One scene with a still fallback.
libraries.failure_fallback: A still image. Do not keep a broken canvas.

libraries.description: Three.js integrated into React.
libraries.install_instructions: Project-scoped. Do not install globally.
libraries.expected_output: One Canvas, lazy-loaded, with disposal on unmount.
libraries.failure_fallback: A still image and no render loop.

libraries.description: Reusable React Three Fiber helpers such as controls and loaders.
libraries.install_instructions: Project-scoped, and only with React Three Fiber. Do not install globally.
libraries.expected_output: Helpers for the one scene.
libraries.failure_fallback: Write the small helper, or drop the control.

libraries.description: Custom procedural GPU effects.
libraries.install_instructions: No package by default. Confirm the license of any shader dependency before adding it. Do not install globally.
libraries.expected_output: One shader with a stated purpose and a still fallback.
libraries.failure_fallback: The still image.

libraries.description: Scene-level visual effects.
libraries.install_instructions: Project-scoped only when a scene effect is required. Do not install globally.
libraries.expected_output: One effect that serves the scene.
libraries.failure_fallback: Render the scene without the effect.

libraries.description: Art-directed animation timelines where a code timeline is the wrong tool.
libraries.install_instructions: Project-scoped only when the brief names Theatre. Do not install globally.
libraries.expected_output: One art-directed timeline.
libraries.failure_fallback: GSAP or Motion, not both on the same element.

libraries.description: DOM and 3D scroll synchronization.
libraries.install_instructions: Project-scoped only when DOM and 3D must share scroll. Do not install globally.
libraries.expected_output: One shared scroll position.
libraries.failure_fallback: GSAP ScrollTrigger or native scroll, not a second scroller.

libraries.description: A Framer project. Not Motion for React.
libraries.install_instructions: Do not install globally. Do not npm-install Framer into an application repo. The deliverable is the Framer project.
libraries.expected_output: A Framer project, separate from the code stack.
libraries.failure_fallback: If the deliverable is code, do not start a Framer project.

libraries.description: Relational source of truth, transactions, constraints, and durable data.
libraries.install_instructions: Do not install globally. Do not introduce a database for a page with no durable data.
libraries.expected_output: A schema with keys, constraints, and indexes justified by queries.
libraries.failure_fallback: Keep the existing database. Do not add a second one.

libraries.description: Managed Postgres with authentication, row level security, storage, and realtime when the product already chose it.
libraries.install_instructions: Do not install globally. Add the client only when the product note names Supabase. Keys stay in the host.
libraries.expected_output: Postgres plus the Supabase features the product actually uses.
libraries.failure_fallback: Plain Postgres.

libraries.description: Cache, TTL, rate limit, or ephemeral state when a requirement names that job.
libraries.install_instructions: Do not install globally. Add Redis only for a named cache, TTL, rate limit, or ephemeral job.
libraries.expected_output: Ephemeral state with a TTL. Not the system of record.
libraries.failure_fallback: Do the work in Postgres, or skip the cache.

libraries.description: TypeScript server runtime for integrations that are not a Python service.
libraries.install_instructions: Do not install globally. Use the repo runtime. Do not add a second runtime for one route.
libraries.expected_output: One Node service.
libraries.failure_fallback: Stay on the runtime the repo already runs.

libraries.description: A small custom HTTP API.
libraries.install_instructions: Do not install globally. Add Express only when the API is not already Next or FastAPI.
libraries.expected_output: A small HTTP API.
libraries.failure_fallback: Use the HTTP layer the repo already has.

libraries.description: Python inference, data processing, and model-serving APIs.
libraries.install_instructions: Project virtualenv. Do not install globally. Do not add Node beside it unless the UI is a separate app.
libraries.expected_output: A typed Python API.
libraries.failure_fallback: Keep the existing Python service.

libraries.description: Background jobs when a Redis-backed queue is justified.
libraries.install_instructions: Project-scoped only together with Redis and a named job. Do not install globally.
libraries.expected_output: A job with a retry policy. Not a second application.
libraries.failure_fallback: Run the work in the request, or skip the queue.
